scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); if(fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.mkdirSync('dist'); const copyDir=(src, dest)=>{ if(!fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.mkdirSync(dest); fs.readdirSync(src).forEach(file=>{ const s=path.join(src,file); const d=path.join(dest,file); if(fs.lstatSync(s).isDirectory()) copyDir(s,d); else fs.copyFileSync(s,d); }); }; copyDir('frontend/dist', 'dist'); console.log('✅ Full build synchronized to root dist/')"
scripts.test: npm run -s seo:check-slugs && npm run -s build:frontend && npm run -s build:backend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
